activation_conditions: Primary goal includes generic energy or vitality.
missing_information_behavior: Do not infer a CoQ10 indication from nonspecific fatigue or low energy.
safety_exclusions: Review potential medication interactions, including anticoagulants and diabetes medicines, before any product consideration.
professional_escalation_conditions: Persistent fatigue, diagnosed disease, cancer treatment, anticoagulant or insulin use, or unexplained symptoms.
population_and_context: Generic wellness/energy claim, not a diagnosed condition-specific indication.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose supported by this rule.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH source page last updated 2019; currentness review and GRADE appraisal required.
